description: Embark on a customized sailing adventure and choose your destination. Egmont Key, Anna Maria, or Shell Key. Opt for Egmont Key to explore a historic island, home to gopher tortoises, remains of Fort Dade, and secluded beaches. Choose Anna Maria for a charming coastal town with picturesque surroundings. While Shell Key is a haven for unspoiled nature with fantastic shelling opportunities. Whichever destination you select, our experienced crew will ensure a fun-filled sailing experience.
